subject.title: fix(msteams): keep post-tool replies from mid-word streaming merges

question: Should this PR wait for live Microsoft Teams personal-DM proof, or is the attached controller-level terminal proof enough for this user-visible channel fix?
rationale: The code path and tests support the source-level fix, but the changed behavior is visible in the Teams client and the contributor states no live tenant proof was run.

options.title: Require live Teams proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted Teams personal-DM recording, transcript, or logs showing a text-preamble to tool-call to final-answer run without the mid-word merged bubble before merge.

options.title: Accept controller proof
options.body: A maintainer can intentionally accept the source-level harness and green focused tests as sufficient when live Teams credentials are unavailable.

recommendation.title: Require live Teams proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted Teams personal-DM recording, transcript, or logs showing a text-preamble to tool-call to final-answer run without the mid-word merged bubble before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: BradGroux merged the prior tool-boundary Teams streaming fix and authored adjacent streaming fallback work on the same controller surface.
